subject: Request: key-wrapping lineage & rotation snapshot for SIG/CAIQ intake (BlueHarbor)
messages:
From: Keith Lambert <keith.lambert@blueharbor.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
Cc: blueharbor-ciso@blueharbor.com, security@blueharbor.com
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: key wrapping lineage & rotation snapshot for SIG/CAIQ intake

Lukas,

As part of our SIG/CAIQ intake for Redwood, the assessment team needs the following artifacts related to tenant key management (scope: blueharbor-prod):

- HSM attestation / vendor seal (most recent) and the operator custody matrix
- Key rotation snapshot that shows KEK/DEK wrap/unwrap events for the past 6 months (CSV export preferred)
- Policy describing KEK wrapping (KMS -> HSM wrapping flow) and any automated rotation windows
- Sample audit logs for wrap/unwrap events (obfuscated tenant IDs is fine, we only need event traces)

Are you able to provide these by EOD Monday (Mar 6)? If timeline is tight, a short delivery plan is fine — we can accept staged evidence.

Keith Lambert
Security Engineer, BlueHarbor Finance
keith.lambert@blueharbor.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: keith.lambert@blueharbor.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: key wrapping lineage & rotation snapshot for SIG/CAIQ intake

Keith — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a staged package:

1) HSM attestation (signed PDF) + operator ACL matrix — deliverable by Fri Mar 3 EOD
2) Rotation snapshot CSV + brief manifest describing columns — deliverable Mon Mar 6
3) Audit log sample (ndjson) + redaction notes — deliverable Mon Mar 6
4) KEK wrapping policy (YAML + short narrative) — deliverable with rotation snapshot

I’ve created a shared evidence folder and will upload the attestation and the operator matrix first. If you need a specific format for the CSV or the log-level, let me know now so we can shape the export.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E_blueharbor_evidence (permission pending — will grant BlueHarbor secops)

I’ll loop in our ops and compliance owners to assemble the exports.

— Lukas Meyer
Director, Security & Compliance (supporting enterprise)
Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: key wrapping lineage & rotation snapshot for SIG/CAIQ intake

Team — forwarding BlueHarbor’s ask above. Concrete tasks below; can you confirm ownership and ETA in-thread? We need to honor Mar 6 for full set, but HSM attestation should go out tomorrow.

- Marissa: pull and validate HSM attestation (vendor-signed PDF) and generate operator custody matrix (who has HSM console access / KMS key ceremony roles). Send both to evidence folder and attach to final response.
- Irene: export rotation snapshot for tenant "blueharbor-prod" covering Aug 2027–Feb 2028. Required columns: timestamp, key_id (hashed), event_type (wrap/unwrap/rotate), actor_id (obfuscated), wrapping_kek_id, wrapped_dek_id, sequence_no. Deliver CSV + short manifest.
- Ben: produce a minimal policy artifact (kek_wrapping_policy.yaml) and a short narrative (2–3 bullets) describing automated rotation windows and fallback. Also prepare a sample audit_log ndjson (max 1k events) with tenant ids masked.

Notes:
- Obfuscate tenant identifiers but keep deterministic hashing so BlueHarbor can correlate across artifacts if they request a verification key.
- Use the evidence naming convention: blueharbor_<artifact>_202803
- Upload artifacts to the Drive folder and mark each file with delivery status in the manifest file.

Please reply with confirmations and any blockers.

Thanks — Lukas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: keith.lambert@blueharbor.com
Cc: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: key wrapping lineage & rotation snapshot for SIG/CAIQ intake

Keith —

We’ve assembled the requested evidence and uploaded the initial package to the shared folder. Deliverables in the root of the evidence folder:

- hsm_attestation_202803.pdf (vendor-signed HSM attestation, includes firmware version and seal)
- operator_matrix_redwood.xlsx (role -> operator list, last access timestamp obfuscated)
- rotation_snapshot_202802.csv (Aug 2027–Feb 2028, columns described in manifest)
- audit_log_sample_202802.ndjson (wrap/unwrap events, tenant IDs hashed with sha256-salt)
- kek_wrapping_policy.yaml (short policy + rotation cadence)
- delivery_manifest_202803.txt (maps files to Redaction/Note/producer)

Access: the folder link is the same as Lukas shared; I’ve granted Viewer access to security@blueharbor.com and Keith’s account. If you need a copy via SFTP or a signed DocuSign acceptance for chain-of-custody, we can initiate that (DocuSign: 0X9ADJ29).

Short summary:
- Rotation cadence: KEKs rotate quarterly (90-day target), automated by orchestrator with emergency rotation playbook if operator count changes or suspected compromise.
- Wrapping: KEKs live in HSMs (FIPS 140-2 Level 3/4 depending on cluster), DEKs are envelope-wrapped per-tenant and stored encrypted in our object store.
- Auditability: wrap/unwrap events are logged with immutable sequence IDs and exported to our audit pipeline; we provided a sample export (first 1k events) with redaction notes.

Let me know if the assessor needs raw (unredacted) identifiers — that requires an NDA amendment and will need a scheduled joint session.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Program Manager, Security Delivery
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: hsm_attestation_202803.pdf (application/pdf), rotation_snapshot_202802.csv (text/csv), kek_wrapping_policy.yaml (text/yaml)
